facts.fact: The Central Bank of Seychelles and Financial Services Authority made the Financial Consumer Protection (Complaint Handling) Regulations 2024 (SI 110 of 2024) under the Financial Consumer Protection Act 2022, applying to all financial services providers listed in the Act's Schedule and in force from 1 January 2025; digital finance is not named.

The regulations give every financial consumer the right to complain to the Competent Authority (the Central Bank of Seychelles or the Financial Services Authority) against a provider's decision, which must investigate and determine within 30 business days; providers must run their own complaint units and answer within 21 business days.

systems.owner: Central Bank of Seychelles and Financial Services Authority

SYC.note: No enforcement figures, fines or sanctions reported; the only penalty is a stated maximum for late provision of complaint records.
